contributions.claim: 单一前馈网络一次前向，从 1 到数百张图像联合预测相机内外参、深度图、点图和点轨迹，无需后处理优化
contributions.mechanism: feed-forward multi-view network that jointly regresses camera parameters, depth maps, viewpoint-invariant point maps (first-camera frame) and tracking features for an arbitrary number of views in one pass, without global alignment / bundle adjustment
keywords: camera and depth joint prediction transformer

contributions.claim: 交替注意力（Alternating-Attention）：逐帧自注意力与全局自注意力交替，仅用自注意力，配合区分首帧的相机/寄存器 token，3D 归纳偏置极少
contributions.mechanism: transformer over DINO patch tokens of all frames that alternates frame-wise self-attention and global (all-frames) self-attention layers (24 pairs), no cross-attention; learnable camera token and register tokens, with a distinct set for the first (reference) frame
known_refs: video transformers with divided space-time attention (TimeSformer)

contributions.claim: 过完备多任务监督（相机、深度、点图、轨迹）能提升精度；推理时用预测的深度+相机反投影得到的点云优于直接点图头
contributions.mechanism: training with redundant/over-complete targets that are related in closed form (camera, depth, pointmap, tracks) improves accuracy; at test time unprojecting predicted depth with predicted cameras beats the dedicated pointmap head

contributions.claim: 预训练 VGGT 作为特征骨干，可提升动态场景点跟踪与前馈新视角合成等下游任务
contributions.mechanism: using a 3D-geometry-pretrained multi-view transformer as the feature backbone (fine-tuned) for dynamic point tracking (CoTracker-style head) and feed-forward novel view synthesis
